decisions.reason: Document capture supports the firm's strategic electronic document workflow direction, and a growing, hiring firm has enough slack to carry it, though the missing 2020–2021 observations add some uncertainty.
Email and fax conversion uses the core fax and messaging infrastructure at low marginal cost, and with no evident shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search to drop it.
This low-cost optimization feature strengthens the established fax business and ties up few resources, so removing it would yield little.
Sandbox threat protection is increasingly demanded by regulated customers and fits the firm's security aspirations, so keeping it meets expectations.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a standard, cheap-to-maintain part of the core secure email offer, so dropping it would weaken the established portfolio.
